pr_title: feat(es/base): Add `TransformConext` to reduce breaking changes
pr_body:
**Description:**

This will force users to create needlessly many input, but this will reduce breaking change.
I want to create an `swc-rs-ecosystem-ci` and this is groundwork for it.


**Related issue:**

 - Closes #8186
pr_comments: Do people really relies on separate compat passes? Maybe only change esxxx and preset-env would be enough?
Some do, but I think it makes sense
But then the problem is that it's a _technically_ breaking change.

issue_context.title: `swc_ecma_transforms_base::TransformContext`
issue_context.body:
All transform functions for compatibility and bugfixes should accept it.

This can be a bit cumbersome, but this will reduce breaking changes due to more assumption required.

```rust

pub struct TransformContext<C> {
    pub comments: C,
    pub assumptions: Assumptions,
    pub unresolved_mark: Mark.
}


```


I'm not sure about the extra fields
comments: Closing due to lack of developer resources
This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.

review_comments: This is actually cleaner, and it also allows future optimization
The constructor drops `Assumptions` early to avoid making difference of memory access
Does this mean that every visitor have to add a generic parameter of type C?
Yes, at least all visitors accept `TransformContext`
